channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rob Hennigan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rob Hennigan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Scott Perry, Rob Hennigan
item.description:
Aaron Gordon:

“It’s just exciting to me. I’ve always trusted Rob Hennigan and I’ve always trusted Scott Perry. To me, it validates my trust in them. They made moves that other people couldn’t have made. They were confident, aggressive moves. Now, it’s on us. We’re ready to play. We have the coach, the staff, the players, the organization. We have a foundation of players who have been there and been through the losing, and now it’s time to start winning.”

Aaron Gordon on Scott Perry, Rob Hennigan, Sep 6, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Rob Hennigan
item.description:
John Denton:.@Kevin Durant on #Magic GM Rob Hennigan whom he got to know during their time in OKC:

“I am a big fan of the Magic & I want to see them do well”

Kevin Durant on Rob Hennigan, Mar 23, 2013. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Rob Hennigan
item.description:

Kevin Durant on Rob Hennigan, Mar 23, 2013. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.
